scope: Standalone verification of published V184 saved ledger and report using the Python standard library only. No model, torch, numpy, datasets, source RGB, weights, feature arrays, or V112 access.
selection: Use the original paired_same_query_RGB_D_vs_E flag and original human_state DIRECT_VISIBLE or EXTERNAL_OCCLUDED. Do not infer cohort membership, repair labels, or filter by model response, quality, owner, coordinates, or reference error.
confusion: Rows original truth D,E; columns saved model response D,E,U. Every selected row occurs once, including abstentions. D/E recalls divide by all corresponding truth rows. Precision divides by all calls of that class. U_rate divides by the full selected population.
comparison: Recalculate all 12 ALL/material model rows with independent scalar loops; exact integer counts and finite float agreement at absolute tolerance 1e-12. Preserve ROOT_PHASE_RESULT and historical independent review bindings as original authority, not a new native physical certification.
storage: Read a relative publication path as raw bytes, gzip bytes, or an explicit parts JSON descriptor. Parts concatenate in listed order after optional per-part gzip decompression. No directory search, original absolute source paths, or remote retrieval.

parts_schema.content_sha256: optional SHA256 of concatenated decompressed content

manifest: Optional files/entries manifest maps logical paths to published paths or storage specs. Manifest v2 uses published_relative for the logical path, PUBLISHED_RAW plus published_sha256 for copied bytes, or PUBLISHED_GZIP_CHUNKS plus embedded gzipchunks descriptor with source_sha256=content_sha256. Unpublished entries have null published_relative and are skipped; CANDIDATE inventory is rejected. All published stored-byte SHA fields and chunk SHA fields are checked without array deserialization.
execution_order: root stages package and authorizes actual package verification
